newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan rupee ends down in kerb, seen falling.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan rupee ends down in kerb, seen falling.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee closed 0.18 rupees down at 43.08 to the dollar on Monday in the kerb amid a rise in dollar demand. Dealers said the rupee was likely to fall further on Tuesday.
They said low supply of the dollar, which had fallen to attractive levels on Sunday, pushed the dollar up sharply and may keep the rupee weak on Tuesday.

The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on October 22, was 40.1200/40.3206 to the dollar. The premium on forex bearer certificates closed at 7.40 percent, against its previous close at 7.20 percent. -- Ovais Subhani 9221-5685192
